hook: Up first. Kettle on. House dark.
One earbud in, a prayer song on.
A son's name sung in it.
disclosure: An illustration made by Sanctoria. Not a customer.
A sample prayer song. Not a customer's song.

captions.text: He carried the candle down Saint Brigid's aisle
A boy in white with a careful smile
Now grown and gone his own long way
He's wandered far from where we pray
Daniel
Lord, call Daniel home to You
captions.name: Daniel

captions.text: Keep the door of mercy wide
Father, hear a mother's plea
I cannot walk his road for him
So into Your hands I let him go

hook: His name is in every chorus.
disclosure: An illustration made by Sanctoria. Not a customer.
A sample prayer song. Not a customer's song.

captions.text: Still every Sunday the telephone rings
He asks how I am and tells me small things
I hold the phone and hear his voice
And ask You, Lord, to guide his choice
Daniel
Lord, call Daniel home to You
captions.name: Daniel

captions.text: Father, hear a mother's plea
Hold my Daniel close to Thee
captions.name: Daniel

captions.text: Mary, pray for him tonight
Keep him ever in your sight

hook: Last thing at night, lamp still on.
Two names in it, prayed once more.
disclosure: An illustration made by Sanctoria. Not a customer.
A sample prayer song. Not a customer's song.

captions.text: I watched my Anna walk in white
captions.name: Anna

captions.text: They knelt together, made their vow
A little boy asleep upstairs
Two cups gone cold beside the chairs
It's been a hard year, Lord, you've seen
The quiet nights, the space between
Soften the words that are hard to hear
Our Lady, pray for these two I love
I cannot mend what is not mine
